to.section: Purpose: bounded, evaluator-driven single-mission improvement loop
Use when: mission and evaluator exist, durable logs, periodic cron rerun
Do not use: runtime evaluator generation, multi-mission, deprecated omc CLI
Contract: single mission, JSON evaluator pass and score, non-pass continues, explicit stops
Required artifacts: mission spec, evaluator, per-iteration JSON, markdown logs, storage layout, reuse runtime artifacts
Workflow: confirm mission, record slug, evaluator ref, iteration count, timestamps, max-runtime
Per iteration: one change cycle, run evaluator, persist JSON, append log, continue on fail
Stop conditions: max-runtime, user cancel, explicit runtime terminal
Cron integration: one mission per job, same contract, append run artifacts
Execution policy: no omc autoresearch hand-back, no multi-mission, reuse src helpers, human-readable logs
